description: Full details for one publishing organization (CKAN organization_show): display name, description, dataset count, and (optionally) a sample of its datasets. Use to learn what a given UK publisher releases.

id.description: Organization id or slug, e.g. "office-for-national-statistics" or "natural-england".

include_datasets.description: If true, include a sample of the org's datasets in "packages" (default false).
